=== BASIC INFORMATION ===

=== EDUCATION ===
1. B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering
   Institution: Indian Institute of Technology (BHU), Varanasi
   Period: 2023-07-01 - 2027-07-01
   Score: 6.75/10

=== SKILLS ===
• Programming
  Keywords: C++, Python, C, SQL
• CS Fundamentals
  Keywords: Data Structures & Algorithms, OOP, DBMS, Operating Systems
• Machine Learning
  Keywords: Collaborative Filtering, Matrix Factorization (SVD), Model Evaluation, NLP Techniques
• Web / Backend
  Keywords: REST APIs, Flask, WebSockets
• Tools
  Keywords: Git, GitHub, Linux, VS Code

=== PROJECTS ===
1. Netflix Recommendation System (Netflix Prize–Style)
   Description: Built a Netflix-style recommendation system leveraging SVD-based collaborative filtering and latent factor models on large scale user–item rating data. Optimized model performance by minimizing RMSE, improving recommendation accuracy over baseline approaches while efficiently handling sparse datasets. Designed end-to-end data preprocessing and evaluation pipelines, including normalization, train–test splitting, and performance analysis.
2. AI Resume Screening Tool
   Description: Developed an NLP-based resume screening system to parse PDF resumes and extract key candidate skills automatically. Implemented a similarity-scoring algorithm to rank candidates against job descriptions, enabling automated and objective candidate shortlisting.
3. Real-Time Chat Application
   Description: Developed a scalable real-time chat application supporting one-to-one and group messaging using WebSockets. Implemented message delivery acknowledgments and robust online/offline user state handling. Designed backend APIs to manage users, chat rooms, and persistent message storage.

=== AWARDS ===
• Codeforces Max Rating: 1100 - Codeforces (None)
• JEE Advanced 2023: AIR 11227 - JEE Advanced (None)
• B.Tech CSE at IIT (BHU) - IIT (BHU) (None)
